note: Protocol P20. The project's own rule sets, which an agent with a distribution_url adds when its configuration does not name them, and what a 404 or 410 from /v1/rule-bundle means to the agent. configured: the agent's configuration names the set. accepted (default false): the agent holds an accepted bundle for the set. withdrawn (default false): the agent holds the set as not assigned (it was last answered 410). agent: not_offered (runs nothing, reports nothing, asks again next scan), not_assigned (stops evaluating, stops using its stored bundle while keeping the rollback floor, health state not_assigned, asks again next scan without current_version) or refused (like any other 4xx: the last accepted bundle keeps running).
